record.oneLiner: Shopify is an ecommerce platform providing comprehensive REST and GraphQL APIs for managing storefronts, products, orders, and merchant operations.
record.verdictReason: Shopify provides comprehensive GraphQL and REST APIs with self-serve developer access via the Dev Dashboard, standard OAuth and API token authentication, and official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server support.

evidence.quote: GraphQL Admin API | Your app, on behalf of a merchant | OAuth, usually token exchange | X-Shopify-Access-Token
Partner API | Your app, scoped to your Partner organization | Create a Partner API client in Organization settings, and use its access token | X-Shopify-Access-Token
You've created an app in the Dev Dashboard.
GraphQL Admin API to read and write store data, including products, orders, customers, and inventory.
If you prefer MCP, you can connect to Shopify's developer resources through the Dev MCP server. The server runs locally and doesn't require authentication.
